documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0: PETG Basic
Bambu PETG Basic Safety Data Sheet SDS20251017G00
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PETG Basic
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 35 ± 6 MPa, elongation 5.2 ± 1.4 %, bending modulus 1740 ± 40 MPa, bending strength 56 ± 4 MPa, impact 10.5 ± 1.8 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density and glass transition are raw-material properties (ISO 1183, DSC) and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows; the registry has no *.printed / *.material key pair, so the split is by key group and test_condition. Vicat and HDT rows do not state their specimen form.

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for the melting temperature (DSC, 10 °C/min) and the SDS says "No data available" for the melting point; filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2780 ± 65 MPa, Z 2550 ± 100 MPa), melt index (22.9 ± 2.4 g/10 min at 245 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), heat deflection temperature 71 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.45% at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.4 – 0.8 mm) and speed (30 - 60 mm/s), chamber temperature (35 – 50 °C), max overhang angle (~ 70 °), max bridging length (~ 30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (not recommended; if done, 60 to 70 °C for 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. Nozzle sizes, printer and AMS compatibility, support material and glue are kept as relations; the Nozzle Size cell is also the extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters row and the Printers Compatibility cell the compat.statement row.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (35 – 50 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.
The spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm) is not written to product.length/width/height: a diameter is not a length and width, and the registry has no spool-size key.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: product name "Bambu PETG Basic", identified use "3D printing filament", CLP "Not classified", no hazard pictogram or signal word, no PBT/vPvB substance or endocrine disruptor, "Not hazardous goods" for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO-TI transport, SVHC and the other REACH lists "Not listed". Its section 9 "No data available" for density does not override the TDS value. Its section 5 says "No data available" for combustion products, while the TDS says "Water, carbon oxides". The SDS model "G00-xx(xx stands for any suffix)" (p.2, section 1) is not written to identity.model: the builder writes identity.model "PETG Basic" from the reviewed identity map, which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace with a designation carrying a wildcard suffix.

Source differences kept for review (none with the store page): nozzle temperature (TDS 230 - 260 °C vs material-table wiki generic "PETG" row 240 - 270 ± 10 °C); bed temperature (TDS 65 - 75 °C vs material-table wiki 60 - 80 °C); oven drying (TDS 65 °C, 8 h vs material-table wiki generic "PETG" 70 ℃, 8 h vs PETG wiki and drying wiki 60 - 65 °C, 8 h); AMS drying (TDS and PETG wiki 65 °C, 8 h vs material-table wiki 65 ℃ for 12 h); heatbed drying (TDS and PETG wiki 80 °C, 12 h vs drying wiki "PETG, PETG-CF" 75-85 °C, 12 h); plates (TDS names the Cool Plate SuperTack, the material-table wiki says "Not recommended" for the Cool Plate / PLA Plate). The product TDS values are kept.

Consistency with the parsed store page: material.diameter 1.75 mm agrees (store bullet "Diameter: 1.75mm +/- 0.03mm"); material.net_weight 1 kg (stored as 1000 g) on the "1kg" Size value agrees with the store option value. safety.certifications is the store page's own bullet (unverified). The store page states no other value that the curated file holds. material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row; the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is neither restated nor marked not_published.

Marketing prose proves no number and is not stored: "now matches the strength of PLA Basic", "strong resistance to water, UV, and temperature", "lower sensitivity to moisture compared to typical PETG filaments" (store page and TDS Basic Info). The store page block "Mechanical Properties Comparison" has no text (an image).

safety.certifications holds only the store page's own UL GREENGUARD claim, in the bullet's words "UL GREENGUARD 2904" (Product Features › bullet 4), status unverified. The Download block links certificate documents that were not cached and not read (Filament RoHS, POPs, CP65, TSCA, SVHC, PAHs (REACH_17.pdf), EN71-3); no certification is keyed from them, and the key is not marked not_published.

material.spool_type is neither stored nor marked not_published: no source names the spool (no "Comes with … Spool" bullet; the TDS gives only spool material and size), and the Spool option group ("Refill" / "Filament with spool") carries the choice.

Hex: the hex table names all 13 store colours exactly once ("Red" ↔ "Red(30201)", "Orange" ↔ "Orange(30301)", "Yellow" ↔ "Yellow(30402)", "Reflex Blue" ↔ "Reflex Blue(30603)", "Navy Blue" ↔ "Navy Blue(30604)", "Misty Blue" ↔ "Misty Blue(30108)", "Green" ↔ "Green(30502)", "Pine Green" ↔ "Pine Green(30503)", "Dark Brown" ↔ "Dark Brown(30800)", "Dark Beige" ↔ "Dark Beige(30403)", "Black" ↔ "Black(30105)", "Gray" ↔ "Gray(30107)", "White" ↔ "White(30106)"). Each hex was read from the text layer and matches the sampled colour of its rendered tile. As published, "Navy Blue" is #0086D6 (a mid blue) and "Reflex Blue" is #001489 (a dark blue); stored as published.

Drying requirement (no key): the store FAQ says to dry before use and, if exposed to air above 50% RH for more than 72 hours, to dry thoroughly; the material-table wiki (generic "PETG") says drying is "Recommended" and desiccant protection "Optional". The PETG wiki gives the default flow ratio of Bambu PETG Basic as 0.95.
The store FAQ (5.Safety Tips) and the PETG wiki say the filament is not food-grade / not food-contact grade; no registry key holds this.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store page also links the wiki page https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool, which was not cached and not read.

Adjudication against the second extraction (125 field disagreements in 265 compared fields), every fact present in one file only or valued differently re-read in the cached TDS (text layer and rendered p.4), SDS, hex table, material-table, PETG and drying wikis and the cached store page. Same fact, this file's form kept (71): locator wording ("p.N, Section › Row" over "p.N › Section › Row") on 19 spec rows, the 13 hex tiles and 7 relations; the cooling fan "0 - 60%" (the TDS's own spelling); safety.certifications "UL GREENGUARD 2904" (the bullet its quote is, not the GREENGUARD section's "UL GREENGUARD (UL 2904)") with the store page as source_url, as in the PETG Matte and PLA Matte files; one ams_series family relation for the TDS AMS Compatibility row rather than four per-unit relations; the Refill requires-spool relation with the store FAQ as evidence and the bambu-reusable-spool handle the FAQ names (the Cautions note "The refill needs to be used with a spool." says the same). Different values, this file's kept (14): thermal.heat_deflection_temp is the ISO 75 1.8 MPa row (68 °C), as in every other filament file, the 0.45 MPa row (71 °C) the second took being in its test_condition; the Build Plate Type, Support Material and Glue rows stay compatible_with relations with their manifest target handles (part / material), as in every sibling filament file, not recommended_with with target kind "other". Present in this file only, kept after re-reading (15): the TDS p.1 nozzle-size relation, the high flow nozzle relation (material-table row "PETG": "Compatible" for the 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8 mm high flow nozzles) and the Engineering Plate relation (material-table plate table, row "PETG / PETG HF / PETG Translucent": 60 - 80 ℃).
